status: Selected from public problem papers before any GeoSolver run or solver outcome; DSL authoring and semantic audit pending
rule: Three source organizations, twenty planar geometry value tasks each. Include construction-only, continuous, discrete, invariant-target and multiple-value tasks. Exclude optimization, strategy games, counting arrangements, general three-dimensional geometry, and integrals/probabilities without a direct finite geometric target. One selected component of a coordinate or angle-ratio answer is explicitly marked as adaptation. Reject a case after selection only for a documented semantic/domain incompatibility, never for observed solver behavior.
split_rule: Within each organization's ordered list, zero-based even indices are mid-study and odd indices are final. Each set has ten cases per organization. Family overlap is reported; source count is not a measure of structural independence.
